verdict.rationale: Swell is a commerce platform, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The pack never mentions MCP. The AI page's "install once and your agent picks up the file contract, the CLI" describes an unnamed agent integration, not a documented MCP server or endpoint, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
